disputed.finding: The report states the first global stocktake was in 2023 and every five years thereafter; this is supported, but the draft should be careful that Article 14(2) says 'first global stocktake in 2023' rather than implying the first one is a recurring procedural deadline independent of COP decision-making.
disputed.objection: The report quotes Article 14(2) accurately and never implies the stocktake timing is independent of COP decision-making, so this caution is speculative.
